patch_description: The beam evaluates many candidates with the same official score, especially while the largest tree size is unchanged. The current tie-handling reconstructs full move histories (often twice) merely to compare path lengths. Within one beam layer all newly generated candidates have the same length, and any candidate from a prior layer is strictly shorter, so an equal official score never requires replacing the saved path. Removing this work substantially increases the number of beam expansions possible within the time limit.
